title: All {count} Mounts in Anime Vanguards
meta_description: Compare Anime Vanguards mounts by availability, unlock type, cost, and obtainment route for faster lobby travel.
intro_md: Mounts make lobby travel faster and give long progression goals a reward you can actually ride. The useful comparison is whether you want to finish an achievement, spend mode tokens, buy a bundle, or wait for an event route to exist.
description_md:
## Choosing an obtainable mount

Availability tells you whether an unlock route is open now. Achievement mounts are steady goals tied to specific clears, while Shop mounts trade currencies from Boss Events, PVP, Dungeons, and other activities. Pick the route that already overlaps with the mode you play, unless you enjoy farming the wrong coin for exercise.

Shop currencies are not interchangeable. A mount sold for PVP Coins needs PVP progress, while Dungeon or Boss Event rewards use their own tokens. Saving the named currency before visiting its shop keeps the grind attached to a real target.

## Bundle and event mount availability

Bundle mounts are tied to their named Robux packs. If a bundle is marked Unobtainable, its old price explains the original route but does not mean the pack can still be bought.

Event mounts can come from limited shops, scores, or event currency. An old event requirement does not promise that the activity or reward will return, so an unavailable mount is better treated as a past reward than a task waiting behind a hidden door.

## Using achievements as mount goals

Achievement mounts connect lobby movement to specific progression clears such as Anomalies, Double Dungeon, Sand Village, and Planet Namak goals. They are useful targets when you prefer earning a mount through play instead of spending Robux or shop currency.

The requirement names matter more than the section label. Finish the exact achievement tied to the mount, then use the faster lobby movement as the victory lap it clearly believes it deserves.
how_it_works_md: Status shows whether the unlock route is available. Unlock type, Cost, and Obtainment explain which activity, bundle, achievement, shop, or currency is tied to each mount.

description_json.Bundles: Bundle mounts come from named Robux packs. An old price describes the original unlock route, while Unobtainable means that route is not currently open.
description_json.Events: Event mounts depend on limited activities, event shops, scores, or temporary currency. A past requirement does not guarantee another chance to earn the reward.
description_json.Achievements: Achievement mounts are earned by completing a named progression challenge. They turn difficult clears into a permanent lobby travel reward.
description_json.Shops: Shop mounts exchange a mode-specific currency for the reward. Match the listed token to its shop because coins from another activity do not cover the cost.

faq_json.q: What do mounts do in Anime Vanguards?
faq_json.a: Mounts let you move through the lobby faster. Their unlock routes come from bundles, events, achievements, or shops.

faq_json.q: Can I still get an Unobtainable mount?
faq_json.a: Not through its listed old route. A retired bundle or event reward should not be expected to return unless the game opens a new way to earn it.

faq_json.q: How do I earn an Achievement mount?
faq_json.a: Complete the exact achievement named in its obtainment requirement. These routes use progression clears instead of a listed shop price.

faq_json.q: Do all Shop mounts use the same currency?
faq_json.a: No. PVP, Dungeon, Boss Event, and other shops use their own currencies, so each mount must be matched with its listed token or coin.

faq_json.q: Does an old Robux price mean a bundle is still for sale?
faq_json.a: No. The price can describe how the mount was originally sold even when the bundle is now marked Unobtainable.

faq_json.q: Will a past event mount return?
faq_json.a: A return is not guaranteed. Past event names and costs explain the original unlock, but only a new in-game event announcement can open another route.

wiki_md: Mounts increase lobby travel speed and come from bundles, events, achievements, or mode shops. Availability matters because many bundle and event routes have ended, while achievement and shop rewards require a specific clear or currency. Pick a route that matches the content you already play, then save the exact token or finish the named challenge.
